blurb: Guests can rent 20L kegs of various Alley Kat beers with optional party pumps. Brewery tours include tasting of newest seasonal beer, an in-depth tour of the brew house, brewery, and canning line, followed by a pint or flight. Tours require advance booking and can accommodate groups up to 12 people or more by arrangement.
